note: N5a. Every threshold of the world scheduler (kernel/world/tiers.gd). Distances are metres from the player to the nearest edge of a plot's footprint (0 = inside). A walk script may override any key under its own "tiers". kernel/world/TIERS.md says what each one does and what was measured.
backdrop_note: outer edge of backdrop; beyond it a pack goes to ledger (unloaded, summary only). 0 = no pack is unloaded for distance.
cost_note: model: a pack tick costs cost_model_ms (a run is then a pure function of its walk script). measured: the world's own clock, smoothed (ema_shift: 1/2^n per tick).
